notes.title: The Roast – HotFix 0.3.4.3 is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Coffee Lovers! ☕

We’ve just pushed a new hotfix that tackles some critical bugs and smooths out the early-game flow.

Updates & Fixes

Seamless Tutorial Transition – Tutorial now flows directly into Day 1 with progress carried over.

Daily Report Fix – Fixed issue where report sometimes didn’t appear.

Customer Queueing Fix – Customers no longer get stuck at the back of the line.

Filter Coffee Machine – Fixed disappearing filters and inability to add new ones after loading.

Save System Cleanup – Saves only created once a day is completed, keeping the list tidy. ✅

Thanks for the quick feedback — keep it coming! 🧡

notes.title: The Roast – HotFix 0.3.4.1
notes.content:
Hello Coffee Lovers! ☕

We’ve just pushed a small hotfix to smooth out some issues from version 0.3.4:

Tray info no longer lingers in the panel after throwing it away.

Cup temperature now properly shows Cold when it should.

Customers will now move to the correct counter if their package is placed there.

Fixed a rare bug where two customers could get stuck at the same counter, freezing the game.

You can no longer place more than one receipt on a tray or paper bag — a warning will pop up instead.

Thanks for the quick feedback — keep it coming!

notes.title: ☕The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.4
notes.content:
Hello Coffee Lovers!

Update 0.3.4 is here! This update introduces multilingual support, a new crowd system, bug fixes, and improvements to make your café even more lively.
Main Updates
New Languages Added – German, French, Italian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Russian.

Crowd System – NPC crowds have been added. People now randomly walk around the environment.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where paper bags held by take-away customers remained in hand after loading a save (only for new saves).

Fixed a bug causing shelf packages to lose their holder references after loading, preventing new item placement.

Fixed an issue where customers could disappear in certain situations.

Fixed a bug where skipping tutorial steps and delivering coffee early caused the tutorial to break.

Fixed an issue where rapidly clicking a package while the customer was receiving it could allow taking it back.

Fixed a bug where taking receipts out of trays or paper bags caused receipt data to be lost, allowing delivery without receipts.

Fixed an issue where adding an undefined cup into a paper bag caused the cup to vanish and become unretrievable.

Fixed some incorrect warnings shown during order delivery.

Fixed a critical bug where delivering a double espresso sometimes prevented XP gain and caused the XP popup to instantly disappear.

Fixed an issue where the carafe kept heating even when empty.
Improvements
Added a UI sensitivity setting (in addition to mouse sensitivity) for computer and terminals.

Receipts can no longer be thrown away.

Updated Paper Bag panel, also added to the carrying panel. Tray now also has a panel.

Added an additional evening ambient sound.

notes.title: ☕ The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.3
notes.content:
Hello Coffee Lovers!

0.3.3 is here! This update brings exciting new features, important bug fixes, and improvements to make managing your coffee shop even more enjoyable.

Main Updates

Tip System – Customers now leave tips based on the order amount and how well it was prepared. Serve with care for extra rewards!

Dirty & Trash Cups – Dine-in cups can now be left dirty or completely unusable. Reusing dirty cups may upset customers or reduce your XP.

XP Feedback on Delivery – See exactly how much XP you earn and why after delivering orders.

Order Tracking Panel – All incoming orders are now listed in a dedicated panel for easier tracking.

Milk Carton & Supply Tracking – Added a panel to show remaining milk in cartons and new entries for carafe, milk & coffee packs, portafilters, coffee jars, and water jugs.

Floating Income/Expense Notifications – Sales, tips, and purchases now appear as satisfying floating text.

Italian Language Support added. 🇮🇹

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where products remained unused if customers were seated at the end of the day.

Fixed rare bug where warning icons stayed above customers after a dog chase.

Lids now correctly return to their holder when placing a cup with a lid.

Addressed potential causes of order panel freezes.

Fixed errors for large cups and double espressos despite correct preparation.



Enjoy the update, and as always, thanks for playing and sharing your feedback. It helps us make the game better every day!

notes.title: ☕ The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello coffee lovers!



Update 0.3.2 is here, and it’s packed with a brand-new language option, important bug fixes, and a small but handy improvement to make your café run smoother.



Main Update

Turkish language support is now available! 🇹🇷

(Change it from the Settings menu)

Bug Fixes

Fixed order panel freeze at closing time.

Fixed storage cup boxes keeping old references.

Fixed box placement requiring looking at the floor first.

Fixed empty cups showing old liquid amounts.

Fixed portafilter coffee value not updating.

Fixed customer pathfinding issues when closing the store.

Fixed day cycle starting the next day instantly.

Improvements

You can now return unused cups to the cup dispenser.

☕ Fresh coffee, fewer bugs — that’s how we like it. Thanks for playing and keep sending us your feedback! ❤️
